title: Voice
atakHint: On your phone: install the Voice plugin in ATAK from the TAK update server.

admin.templatesKeep: Adds the template's nets that are missing; existing nets stay as they are.
admin.applied_zero: No new nets: the template's nets already exist.
admin.applied_one: 1 new net added from the template.
admin.applied_other: {{count}} new nets added from the template.
admin.renameMovesOut: Renaming recreates the net: anyone connected in it or its sub-nets is moved out.
admin.clearExportFirst: Export the channel plan first if you may need it again.
admin.lastMemberNobody: {{callsign}} is the last member. Without members nobody can use this net.
admin.lastMemberOnly_one: {{callsign}} is the last member. Without members only members of {{nets}} can use this net.
admin.lastMemberOnly_other: {{callsign}} is the last member. Without members only members of {{nets}} can use this net.
admin.accessMission: TAK subscribers only, managed in ATAK Data Sync
admin.membersKept_one: 1 member kept in case the net is made members-only again
admin.membersKept_other: {{count}} members kept in case the net is made members-only again
admin.firstMember: Adding the first member makes this net members-only; others connected are moved out.
admin.confirmNarrow: Those connected who are not let in any more are moved out.
admin.groupOnline: {{count}} in this net or its sub-nets now

talk.title: Talk in the browser
talk.intro: Join a voice net from this device. The browser asks to use the microphone; headphones prevent echo.
talk.listenOnly: You can only listen in this net.
talk.denied: You may not enter that net.
talk.pressKey: Press the key or side mouse button you want (Esc cancels)

failure.unsupported: This browser cannot do voice. Use a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari.
failure.mic: Could not use the microphone. Allow it in the browser's settings.
failure.unknown: Voice does not know your callsign yet. An admin can fix that in Deploy App.
failure.rejected: The voice server refused the connection.
